text: Tuma nde Joomi maa -an Annabiijo- wahyinaynoo e Malaa'ikaaɓe ɓeydiraaɓe gomɗimɓe ɓen badri : "Min Miɗo wonndi e mo'on -Malaa'ika'en- : semmbinee tun gomɗimɓe ɓen ka hare. Arma Mi bugoo kulol tiiɗungol e ɓerɗe heeferɓe ɓen. Tappee -onon ɓee gomɗimɓe- daaɗe heeferɓe ɓen no ɓe maayira, tappon e maɓɓe kala ka fontotoo ñobboo e maɓɓe haa ɓe yana ngam be horo habde e mon.
